title: Wealth Inequality Adventure
meta_desc: Inequality in the UK Adventure 1 — KS3 Sociology on wealth and income inequality.
final_note: You learned about UK income and wealth gaps and what they mean.

concepts.def: Total value of what you own

walkthroughs.body_html:
The richest 10% of UK households earn about 9 times more than the poorest 10%.

The gap is one of the bigger ones in Europe.

Wealth (homes, savings) is even more uneven.

The richest 1% own more than the poorest 50% combined.

The Gini coefficient runs from 0 (everyone equal) to 1 (one person has everything).

The UK's Gini is around 0.35 — middling for rich countries.
